messages:
jamie (AE): quick one from FinRegCo POC — they want tenant isolation + confirmation that EU tenants never egress to non-EU infra. they asked for an e2e network path diagram and a short note on subprocessors. can we provide?
ajamie (AE): also flagged pricing impact if we have to pin models/instances to eu region (they'll probably want reserved capacity).
ashok (SE): short answer: yes we can pin and restrict routing, but need to clarify scope — control plane vs data plane. hosted control plane may be global unless they opt for Private. data plane (inference GPUs + KV cache + storage) can be restricted to EU regions.
ashok (SE): details i can share: - routing policy: region_preference -> prefer-eu -> hard-pin-eu fallback: none (fail request) or permissive (fallback to non-eu model). we need to know which they want.
ashok (SE): example config snippet (pseudo):
```
routing: {
  policy: "hard_pin",
  allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"]
}
```
jamie (AE): they asked for "hard_pin" (no fallthrough) in the questionnaire.
jamie (AE): what about subprocessors? they want a list of cloud vendors + support partners operating in eu.
sara (Infra PM): we have EU subprocessors: GCP eu-west-1, GCP eu-central-1, and partner infra providers for private racks (vendor list). also KMS/HSM for key management is customer-choice in Private; for Hosted we use our KMS + CMKs from vendor — list is in compliance pack.
sara (Infra PM): i'll attach the subprocessor inventory doc link in a follow-up.
kyle (Security): from security side, confirm TLS 1.2+, mTLS for intra-region control plane, and we support E2E encryption at rest. for hosted with hard_pin, we still have control-plane metadata flows to our global control plane unless they choose Private. that needs to be clear in the DPA.
jamie (AE): customer explicitly said control-plane traffic to non-EU control plane is okay if sensitive payloads never leave EU. they want assurance that model input/output + logs stay in-region.
kyle (Security): we can redact or obfuscate logs and disable telemetry for that tenant. we also have tokenization hooks and prefix/KV cache residency config.
nashok (SE): NOTE on model variants: some large open models are only in certain regions due to licensing/replication. if a requested model variant isn't replicated to EU, a hard_pin will make that model unavailable unless we replicate. replication cost = storage + cross-region transfer + ops.
jamie (AE): pls give a ballpark of replication cost & timeline — FinRegCo wants pricing for Europe-only footprint vs global.
sara (Infra PM): replication cost depends on model size; e.g., 50B param quantized image ~ 40–120GB. replication + validation pipeline usually 48–72 hours, cost ~ one-time storage + ~0.2–0.5 USD per GiB for transfer/ops in our estimate. i'll get precise numbers.
nashok (SE): another pricing lever: dedicated reserved pools in EU — predictable throughput and avoids cross-region latency. can offer 10% discount for 12-month commit.
jamie (AE): great. can you summarize as a short bullet doc i can hand to their procurement?
kyle (Security): action for legal: confirm DPA language about control plane metadata and subprocessor disclosure.
legal-bot: automated note: latest DPA template v3.2 includes subprocessor disclosure + option for private control plane.
jamie (AE): olivia from FinRegCo — can you confirm they want: 1) hard_pin data plane to EU, 2) control plane permissive, 3) dedicated reserved capacity quote?
olivia (Customer): yes that's correct. also please include list of public egress IPs we can whitelist and whether we provide a signed SOC report.
sara (Infra PM): egress IP ranges: we can provide per-region IP set (will be CIDR list). note: hosted autoscaling may introduce additional ephemeral IPs; for strict whitelisting in prod we recommend Private or Dedicated with NAT gateway whose egress IPs are fixed.
kyle (Security): we can provide SOC2 report and ISO cert snippets. full attestation available through our compliance portal after NDA.
jamie (AE): next steps: ashok to create short presales doc (routing policy + config + ops impact + replication cost estimate) sara to add subprocessor + egress IP CIDRs kyle to draft security blurb on telemetry/logs/legal-bot to confirm DPA options. i'll coordinate & send to olivia.
ashok (SE): i'll draft doc and include a mini-runbook for the POC (what to expect during validation, tests to run). target EOD PST.
sara (Infra PM): i'll have subproc list + IPs by EOD PT as well.
kyle (Security): i'll add notes on encryption at rest, key management options, and telemetry disable.
olivia (Customer): thanks — tight timeline but appreciate it. can we sync tomorrow 09:00 CET for a 30m call?
jamie (AE): yes, booked 09:00 CET. invite sent. :calendar:
deploy-bot: notice: eu-west-1 inference pool capacity increased by 2 nodes to support presales POC (automated scaling).
jamie (AE): perfect, thanks everyone.
(THREAD END)
